name: Susano Yua
source:
“How about working at Furinkan?”
“Just while you’re in this village.”

A young woman who works at the Fuurinkan Hotel.

She’s a genuine local, having been born and raised in Okunezato. While she has an extremely cheerful and positively endearing personality, she’s also a bit of a klutz and is always asking people if they’ve seen her cell phone.

She loves video games and plays everything from current-gen games with realistic graphics to 8-bit classics from thirty years ago. She’s so far gone, she’s practically made of pixels.
